title: Resume paused sessions dialog is marked aria-modal but has no focus trap or backdrop
outcome: The "Resume paused sessions" dialog behaves as a modal: focus moves into it and stays there while it is open, Escape closes it, and the page behind it cannot be used, so its aria-modal claim is true.
acceptance: Resume paused sessions dialog is marked aria-modal but has no focus trap or backdrop is done
disposal_reason: Fixed inside w-e8c7db25b458, which landed as master 29ad6709 (seal 464c4ff4). The Resume paused dialog renders through a portal in the shared .dialog-backdrop; its list scrolls while the controls stay in view; Escape and a backdrop click dismiss it; focus moves in and is restored on close; Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it. Behaviour tests were added. The remaining app-shortcut focus gap is tracked separately as w-9ae0ca2b44c5.
